subject.title: Memory MVP: define SQLite schema and canonical record model

question: Should the typed canonical durable memory record model be added to the bundled memory-core SQLite store now, or should this stay behind a plugin/API design until the recommended memory path is chosen?
rationale: The current product stores durable memory as Markdown and uses SQLite for indexing; changing the source of truth affects the memory plugin boundary, migrations, review/edit/forget flows, and related MVP issues.

options.title: Design memory-core schema first
options.body: Approve a bounded bundled memory-core schema/migration design that also covers provenance and write/review flows before implementation.

options.title: Keep as plugin/API design
options.body: Defer core schema work and define the plugin/API seam needed for an external or future recommended memory plugin to own canonical records.

options.title: Close as not planned
options.body: Reject typed canonical records for now and keep Markdown plus search index as the memory source of truth.

recommendation.title: Design memory-core schema first
recommendation.body: Approve a bounded bundled memory-core schema/migration design that also covers provenance and write/review flows before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest history on the memory search/index and plugin-host boundary that this schema would alter.
